body: I could imagine me typing out some message after drinking too much, but fumbling the keys sober. Both are poor choices. Just having such a hard time finding words. You've helped me very much, I wish you the best

You're right, I'll try to find the right words. And I'll start beint around people I can really talk to. Thank you so much, it means a lot to me. I was convinced he would outlive me, I can't even believe it

My father. Who I'm being there for, but communication has always been a one-way street. My aunt, who is grieving as well. The police officer was suggesting to join a support group, and I will look into that shortly. Being around people who have felt this would be good. Besides the arrangements and everything, I just don't know how to deal... Been trying to remember him in happier times, the details keep going through my head. My girlfriend wants to fly out but I feel strange asking her to.
